bundle.shortDescription: Dashboard for the delegation-core local AI vault
bundle.longDescription: Desktop dashboard for delegation-core, a local MCP delegation server (llama.cpp + BGE embeddings + ChromaDB over an Obsidian vault). Browse and search vault notes, explore the knowledge graph, monitor engine status, and track long-running processes.
